task: Enable ProofStory gate enforcement for future stories.
outcome: When the user or an agent runs future Lattice phase transitions, missing ProofStory DEV, REVIEW, or DONE evidence is rejected instead of only being reported as observe-mode diagnostics.
facts: B-5082 completed the ProofStory M0-M9 implementation and version 0.3.113 is built.
The current repository lattice.config.json has no proofStory block, so dev/review/done gate modes default to observe.
core/machine.ts and handlers/phase-gates.ts already consume proofStory.devGateMode, reviewGateMode, and doneGateMode when configured.
constraints: Do not change ProofStory implementation code unless a gate bug is discovered.
The rollout story must satisfy its own ProofStory gate artifacts before enforce mode is relied on.
Existing active stories may need to add artifacts on their next phase transition; this story should not silently retrofit them.
